newsitem.title: GERMANY: OVER 300 DUE AT FRANKFURT AIR FREIGHT DAYS.
newsitem.headline: OVER 300 DUE AT FRANKFURT AIR FREIGHT DAYS.

text.p: More than 300 trade visitors are expected at the 10th International Frankfurt Air Freight Days on September 24-25, its organisers said.
The event's joint organisers, Lufthansa Cargo AG (LCAG) and Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG), said they expected at least as many conference delegates as at the previous event in 1995.

Frans Peeters, LCAG marketing manager Germany, said customer logistics needs would be the key theme of the Air Freight Days, held at the airport's Sheraton Hotel under the "Cargo meets Customers" slogan.
Representatives of Siemens AG, Volkswagen AG and American medical technology firm Abbott Diagnostika would present logistics concepts, he added.
Speakers included Greenpeace International chief executive Thilo Bode, Dianne Amer, of Intel Europe and three professors of business and production.

Bernhard Lessmann, FAG freight logistics marketing manager, said visitors would be able to see the new German Railways (DB) CargoSprinter freight train which will start regular shuttle services between Frankfurt airport and northern Germany on October 1.

TIACA, the International Air Cargo Association, will also hold its annual meeting parallel to the International Frankfurt Air Freight Days, he noted. - Reu0ters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax: 5017 - www.racs.com
